name: Trumpet's Call
description: The light freighter later known as the Trumpet's Call was used by the Rebel Alliance in the Mid Rim. It changed its name frequently, formerly being known as the Eyesore and the Careful Buyer. During the Mid Rim Retreat, the freighter was attacked and seized by the Galactic Empire, who planted spies aboard and sent it to a rebel flotilla in the Elochar sector without life support.
